subject: epilepsiae_1125

short_history.selection_basis: no candidate met the quorum; the longest registered candidate replaces it
short_history.rule: each INNER needs >=80% of 30-minute-horizon queries with episode age>=H, published coverage>=0.5 and support-end age<=H/2; candidates are replaced, never added
short_history.inputs_read: query times, episode age, published exposure, support end; no loss, morphology or seizure outcome

memory_support.definition: short-window coverage>=0.5, support-end age<=H/2 and at least 30 further minutes of legal published exposure before the short window
memory_support.caveat: a sufficiently observed quiet history is valid information, but it does not license the claim that several earlier events were integrated

support_classes.window_not_observable: the amplifier record does not cover the window
support_classes.observed_but_unpublished: the window was recorded but no block covering it had been released
support_classes.partially_published: some of the observable seconds were released by query time
support_classes.published_and_quiet: fully published exposure carrying zero interictal events
support_classes.published_with_events: fully published exposure carrying at least one event

release.offline_reason: seizure and post-ictal boundaries are clinically annotated after the fact; they already define the registered conditional-interictal scope, and they are supplied identically to every arm, so they support offline conditional analysis rather than prospective claims
release.release_streams: count and marks share one closed one-hour block release in the current packets; both ages are exported separately so an asynchronous stream would be visible
release.explicit_history_excluded: H (recent readable event content) is a consumer input and is not folded into C

inner0.scaler_support: fit_scaling reads packets and events through train_packet only
inner0.right_context: packet marks close with their one-hour block; the block release is the earliest verifiable publication and already bounds the right context

inner1.scaler_support: fit_scaling reads packets and events through train_packet only
inner1.right_context: packet marks close with their one-hour block; the block release is the earliest verifiable publication and already bounds the right context

outer.scaler_support: fit_scaling reads packets and events through train_packet only
outer.right_context: packet marks close with their one-hour block; the block release is the earliest verifiable publication and already bounds the right context

limitations: INNER0 reaches the two-hour support rule on 1/12 main-horizon queries; two-hour eligibility is not broadly satisfied and the earlier-history contrast is weakly supported on that origin
neither 30 nor 120 minutes met the 80% quorum on both INNER origins, so the longest registered candidate replaced the shorter one under the pre-registered rule
count and marks share one closed one-hour block release; a distinct earlier count publication time is not inferred
